timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹123.85 Cr (+75.9% YoY), net profit ₹16.44 Cr (against a loss of ₹9.87 Cr a year earlier).
2026-04-26: Q4FY26 investor presentation — total income ₹134.59 Cr (+72% YoY), PBT ₹3.41 Cr before exceptional items, and a ₹112 Cr Navi Mumbai building sale announced.
Aurum PropTech Limited shared Q4 FY 2025-26 earnings call recording on April 27, 2026, available on its website.

2026-04-30: Q4FY26 earnings call transcript — revenue from continuing operations ₹123.85 Cr (+10.2% QoQ), second consecutive profitable quarter, distribution segment ~60% of total income; Q5/Q6 building sale to make the company debt-free by 30 June 2026.
Aurum PropTech filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 showing ₹37.57 Cr unutilised rights issue proceeds.
2026-05-21: Aurum PropTech completed the sale of Buildings Q5 and Q6 in Navi Mumbai for ₹112 Cr, fully prepaid its LRD facility and said it is debt-free.
2026-06-05: Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited filed its Regulation 31(4) disclosure for FY26 — promoter group holds 3,64,89,367 shares with no encumbrance during the year.

Q1FY27: Aurum PropTech reports third consecutive profitable quarter with 71% YoY revenue growth to ₹111.84 Cr; announces Housing.com acquisition to create India's largest AI-native real estate operating system.

2026-10-13: Aurum PropTech allotted 51,00,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Aurum RealEstate Developers Limited at ₹231.421 each, ₹118.02 Cr in all, with ₹29.51 Cr (25%) received on allotment.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹130.19 Cr (+57.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹4.51 Cr (against a loss of ₹8.56 Cr a year earlier).
Aurum PropTech released its Q2 FY2027 investor presentation showing total income of ₹137.31 Cr (+57% YoY) and adjusted EBITDA of ₹15.44 Cr.
Aurum PropTech Limited shared Q2 FY 2026-27 earnings call recording on October 16, 2026, via its website.
